integrity: Exact analytic proof plus separately implemented direct-benefit root bracketing and sign checks; independent scientific audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Model-conditional deterministic statement. Does not address finite-population stochastic stability, unequal stages, or collision/boundary regimes. Known probability-mixture identities may overlap with the algebraic ingredient.
scientific_scope: Pair-approximation weak-selection adaptive dynamics of continuous public-goods investments on infinite regular graphs (group size at least four), with two equal-amplitude/equal-slope increasing logistic benefit stages and linear individual costs.
title: Four interior investment strategies from two increasing public-good thresholds
